messages.content: 今天北京的日落時間是什麼時候？

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to look up the sunset time right now. The tool I have access to can only calculate sunrise times. If you’d like, I can give you the sunrise time for Beijing today instead.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天北京的日落時間是什麼時候？" They want the sunset time for Beijing today. The tool provided calculates sunrise, not sunset. There's no tool for sunset. We can approximate or say we don't have that capability. According to policy, we cannot hallucinate. So we should respond that we can't provide sunset time because the tool only calculates sunrise. We can offer to calculate sunrise if needed.
